note: Part 4.5 adversarial case. Still a real recall notice in shape, but built to attack both halves of the output contract at once: the salient product terms are long hyphenated compounds that overrun the 30-character tag limit, and the notice carries three separate hazards, two firms, four lot ranges and six states, so any summary that stays faithful to the content runs well past 25 words.
title: Northgate Provisions Hydrolyzed-Vegetable-Protein-Seasoning-Blend Multipack and Ready-To-Heat Chicken-And-Wild-Rice Soup Concentrate, 32 oz institutional tubs
content: Northgate Provisions LLC, together with its co-manufacturer Alder Creek Thermal Processing Inc., is voluntarily recalling all 32 oz institutional tubs of Hydrolyzed-Vegetable-Protein-Seasoning-Blend Multipack and all 32 oz institutional tubs of Ready-To-Heat Chicken-And-Wild-Rice Soup Concentrate. The affected product carries lot codes NGP-4471 through NGP-4489, NGP-5102 through NGP-5140, ACT-0088 through ACT-0097, and ACT-1330 through ACT-1362, with best-by dates from 2027-01-04 to 2027-01-19 and from 2027-06-02 to 2027-06-27. Three separate problems were found during a single post-market review. First, the seasoning blend contains undeclared soy protein isolate and undeclared wheat protein that do not appear on the finished-goods label. Second, environmental swabbing at the co-manufacturer returned a presumptive positive for Listeria monocytogenes on a post-lethality contact surface used for both products. Third, four foodservice customers reported stainless steel wire fragments between two and nine millimetres in length in the soup concentrate, traced to a degraded inline strainer basket. The product was distributed to foodservice and institutional customers in Oregon, Washington, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, and northern California between 2026-05-18 and 2026-09-02, and a limited quantity reached two school nutrition cooperatives. Institutional customers should immediately discontinue use, quarantine all affected tubs, complete the effectiveness check form supplied by the recalling firm, and contact Northgate Provisions customer quality assurance for disposition instructions and credit.
